movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms are used to manipulate the fringed shawl to mimic butterfly wings.

signature_moves.description: The movement of the shawl fringe to mimic the wings of a butterfly.
signature_moves.name: Shawl fluttering

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Must coincide with the drum beat.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Medium war beat, ruffle, crow hop, and fast beat.
music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by the rhythmic pulse of the drum, alternating between various beats like the crow hop and fast beat to challenge the dancer.
